title: Similarity and superrigidity for transverse measured groupoids
summary: Let $G$ be a locally compact, second countable, unimodular group and let $(X,μ,Y)$ be an ergodic integrable transverse $G$-system. We show that $G \ltimes X$ endowed with the product measure and the restriction $(G \ltimes X)|_Y$ endowed with the transverse measure are similar ergodic groupoids. As a consequence, we prove a superrigidity phenomenon for higher rank transverse groupoids. More precisely, for $i=1,\ldots,k$, let $\mathbf{G}_i$ be a connected, simply connected, semisimple algebraic group over some local field $κ_i$ of characteristic zero.
